description: Backend: update Payment model + add schedule/customers/vehicles/payments admin controller functions + update serviceController.getServices + rewire adminRoutes.js
steps: 1. UPDATE server/src/models/Payment.js: rename 'booking' field to 'bookingId' (ObjectId ref Booking, required, unique), rename 'customer' to 'customerId' (ObjectId ref User, required). Change method enum to ['cod','online']. Change status enum to ['unpaid','pending','paid','failed','refunded'] with default 'unpaid'. Add fields: gatewayOrderId (String), gatewayPaymentId (String), gatewaySignature (String), transactionReference (String), collectedAt (Date), collectedBy (ObjectId ref User), refundAmount (Number), refundReason (String), refundedAt (Date). Keep timestamps:true.

2. UPDATE server/src/models/Schedule.js: add '_id: true' to blockedPeriodSchema and holidaySchema (remove '_id: false') so subdoc documents have _id fields needed for removeBlockedPeriod/removeHoliday pull operations.
3. ADD to server/src/controllers/adminController.js (imports at top): import Schedule from '../models/Schedule.js' and import Vehicle from '../models/Vehicle.js'. Do NOT remove any existing exports.
4. ADD export const getSchedule to adminController.js: Schedule.findOne(), return {success:true, data: schedule || {}}.

5. ADD export const updateSchedule to adminController.js: destructure {workingDays, openingTime, closingTime, slotIntervalMinutes, maxConcurrentBookings, breaks} from req.body; validate openingTime/closingTime match /^\d{2}:\d{2}$/ if provided; findOneAndUpdate({}, {$set:{...fields provided}}, {upsert:true, new:true, setDefaultsOnInsert:true}); return {success:true, data:schedule}.

6. ADD export const addBlockedPeriod to adminController.js: {label, startAt, endAt} from body; validate both parseable dates, startAt<endAt, both in the future; $push to blockedPeriods with {label, startAt:new Date(startAt), endAt:new Date(endAt)}; upsert:true, new:true; return {success:true, data:schedule}.

7. ADD export const removeBlockedPeriod to adminController.js: $pull from blockedPeriods where _id matches req.params.periodId (use mongoose.Types.ObjectId or cast via mongoose); return {success:true, data:schedule}.
8. ADD export const addHoliday to adminController.js: {date, label} from body; validate date matches /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/; $push to holidays; return {success:true, data:schedule}.
9. ADD export const removeHoliday to adminController.js: $pull from holidays where _id matches req.params.holidayId; return {success:true, data:schedule}.

10. ADD export const getCustomers to adminController.js: page/limit from query. Build User match filter {role:'customer'} plus optional search regex on name/email/phone. Use User.aggregate: $match, $lookup bookings (from:'bookings', localField:'_id', foreignField:'customerId', as:'bookings'), $addFields {totalBookings:{$size:'$bookings'}}, $project (exclude bookings array), $sort {createdAt:-1}, $skip, $limit. Also count with a separate $match+$count or User.countDocuments. Return {success:true, data:{customers,total,page,pages}}.

11. ADD export const getCustomerDetails to adminController.js: User.findById(id); if not found throw AppError 404. Aggregate booking stats: [{$match:{customerId:mongoose.Types.ObjectId(id)}},{$group:{_id:null,total:{$sum:1},completed:{$sum:{$cond:[{$eq:['$status','completed']},1,0]}},pending:{$sum:{$cond:[{$eq:['$status','pending']},1,0]}},cancelled:{$sum:{$cond:[{$eq:['$status','cancelled']},1,0]}}}}]. Load vehicles: Vehicle.find({owner:id}). Load recent 5 bookings: Booking.find({customerId:id}).sort({startAt:-1}).limit(5).populate('serviceId','name').populate('vehicleId','make model type licensePlate'). Return {success:true, data:{customer, stats:bookingStats[0]||{total:0,completed:0,pending:0,cancelled:0}, vehicles, recentBookings}}.

12. ADD export const getAdminVehicles to adminController.js: page/limit from query. Build filter: if req.query.type set filter.type=req.query.type; if req.query.search build regex on licensePlate. Vehicle.find(filter).populate('owner','name email phone').sort({createdAt:-1}).skip(skip).limit(limit). Return {success:true, data:{vehicles:items, total, page, pages}}.

13. ADD export const getPayments to adminController.js: page/limit from query. Build filter: method if provided, status if provided. Payment.find(filter).populate({path:'bookingId', select:'bookingReference serviceNameSnapshot startAt customerId', populate:{path:'customerId',select:'name email phone'}}).sort({createdAt:-1}).skip(skip).limit(limit). Return {success:true, data:{payments:items, total, page, pages}}.

14. ADD export const recordCODCollection to adminController.js: Payment.findById(req.params.id); if not found throw 404; if method!=='cod' throw AppError('Payment is not COD',400); if status!=='unpaid' throw AppError('Payment already processed',400); set payment.status='paid', payment.collectedAt=new Date(), payment.collectedBy=req.user._id; await payment.save(); update booking: Booking.findByIdAndUpdate(payment.bookingId,{paymentStatus:'paid'}); get customerId from populated booking or from payment.bookingId lookup; create Notification({user:customerId, title:'Payment Collected', body:'Your COD payment for booking has been collected.', type:'payment', data:{paymentId:payment._id}}); populate payment.bookingId before returning; return {success:true, data:payment}.

15. UPDATE server/src/controllers/serviceController.js getServices: change first line of try block from 'const filter = { isActive: true }' to 'const filter = req.query.includeInactive === \'true\' ? {} : { isActive: true };'

16. REWRITE server/src/routes/adminRoutes.js: keep existing imports for protect/requireAdmin/validate/serviceRules/getBookingById/bookingController. Remove import of getAllVehicles from vehicleController, remove import of getAllPayments/updatePaymentStatus from paymentController, remove import of setSchedule from availabilityController. Import all new functions from adminController: getSchedule, updateSchedule, addBlockedPeriod, removeBlockedPeriod, addHoliday, removeHoliday, getCustomers, getCustomerDetails, getAdminVehicles, getPayments, recordCODCollection (alongside existing getDashboard, getAdminReports, getAdminBookings, updateBookingStatus). Add all new routes as specified. Replace GET /vehicles with getAdminVehicles. Replace GET /payments with getPayments, remove old PUT /payments/:id/status, add PATCH /payments/:id/collect.
acceptance_criteria: Payment.js exports a Mongoose model with bookingId, customerId fields and status enum including 'unpaid'
Schedule.js blockedPeriodSchema and holidaySchema have _id:true (subdocs get auto _id)

adminController.js exports getSchedule, updateSchedule, addBlockedPeriod, removeBlockedPeriod, addHoliday, removeHoliday, getCustomers, getCustomerDetails, getAdminVehicles, getPayments, recordCODCollection without removing existing exports
serviceController.js getServices returns all services (including inactive) when ?includeInactive=true

adminRoutes.js loads without error and registers GET/PUT /schedule, POST/DELETE /schedule/block, POST/DELETE /schedule/holiday, GET /customers, GET /customers/:id, GET /vehicles (getAdminVehicles), GET /payments (getPayments), PATCH /payments/:id/collect
verification: cd c:\Users\Dell\Desktop\PROWASH\server && node -e "import('./src/models/Payment.js').then(m=>{const p=m.default.schema.paths; console.log('bookingId:', !!p.bookingId, 'customerId:', !!p.customerId, 'status:', p.status.enumValues.join(','))})"
findings: All 4 verification commands passed. Payment.js: bookingId/customerId renamed, status enum now includes 'unpaid', method enum updated to ['cod','online'], gateway/refund/collection fields added. Schedule.js: _id:true on blockedPeriodSchema and holidaySchema. adminController.js: 11 new exports added (getSchedule, updateSchedule, addBlockedPeriod, removeBlockedPeriod, addHoliday, removeHoliday, getCustomers, getCustomerDetails, getAdminVehicles, getPayments, recordCODCollection) alongside all existing exports. serviceController.js: getServices now supports ?includeInactive=true. adminRoutes.js: fully rewritten — removed old vehicle/payment/availability imports, all new routes wired up.
